operations.note: The instruction also deletes the comma immediately before the deleted words (и запетаята пред тях); the closed set has no segment for that comma, so the comma after 'ал. 1, т. 1' must be removed as well.

The instruction first places a comma at the end of the alinea (накрая се поставя запетая) and then adds the quoted words after it; the closed set has no segment for the comma, so the result must read '...за съответната длъжност, а когато е предвидено...' before the final full stop.

The instruction also deletes the comma immediately before the deleted words (и запетаята пред тях); the closed set has no segment for that comma, so the comma after 'чл. 5, ал. 1, т. 1' must be removed as well.
